reasoning: The icon is a specialized photo-editing UI control for decreasing shadow intensity (a circle split into a crescent and diagonal hatch lines, paired with a minus sign). Because it represents an abstract image-adjustment parameter rather than a concrete object or common life activity, and easily resembles a volleyball or moon icon at small sizes, it is poorly suited as a general to-do list icon.
